extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts from net income (loss) available to common shareholders (not net income before NCI). FFO total of 20,152 is the 'FFO applicable to common shares and Units' line; the diluted FFO line (20,312, after adding back 160 preferred dividends) is not used as the subtotal. Core FFO subtotal 23,303 likewise; diluted Core FFO 23,463. Share count 18,269 (thousands) reproduces $1.11 (20,312/18,269) and $1.28 (23,463/18,269) diluted per-share figures. Company reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Dash (—) lines entered as 0. The swap line combines termination, amortization and mark-to-market; categorized as derivative_mtm. Other miscellaneous items are described by the company as (gain) loss on investments. No AFFO section exists, so recurring capex is not applicable and set null.
